Definition: properly, to put in commotion; by implication, to disturb, drive, destroy
BiblicalUsage: 1) to move noisily, confuse, make a noise, discomfit, break, consume, crush, destroy, trouble, vex; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to move noisily; 1a2) to confuse, discomfit, vex
